# wayscloud_storage_tiers (Data Source)

Fetches the list of available WAYSCloud S3 storage tiers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wayscloud_storage_tiers" "all" {}

output "available_tiers" {
  value = data.wayscloud_storage_tiers.all.tiers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `tiers` (Attributes List) List of available storage tiers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))

<a id="nestedatt--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Price currency (e.g., `NOK`, `EUR`).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the storage tier.
- `id` (String) Tier identifier.
- `name` (String) Tier display name.
- `price_per_gb` (Number) Price per GB/month in customer's currency.
